question: According to the Bloomberg Billionaires Index, who became the first footballer in history to achieve billionaire status before Lionel Messi?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Cristiano Ronaldo**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **Lionel Messi** has officially become a billionaire, joining **Cristiano Ronaldo** as the only two footballers to reach this elite financial status.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• According to the **Bloomberg Billionaires Index**, **Lionel Messi** is the second footballer to reach billionaire status.
 
• **Cristiano Ronaldo** was the **first footballer** to achieve this milestone, reaching it following his **2023** move to the Saudi Arabian club **Al-Nassr**.
 
• Messi's wealth is attributed to over **$700 million** in salaries and bonuses earned since **2007**, supplemented by a portfolio of **investments and endorsements**.
 
• The report notes that while **Ronaldo** used an aggressive marketing strategy, **Messi's** rise to wealth was a more gradual process involving family guidance and strategic partnerships in **Europe and the United States**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Lionel Messi** currently plays as a captain for **Inter Miami** in the **Major League Soccer (MLS)**.
 
• A street in **Berkeley Heights, New Jersey**, has been officially named **'Leo Messi Way'** (a section of **Sherman Avenue**) to honor his impact ahead of the **2026 FIFA World Cup**.
 
• Messi is an **eight-time Ballon d'Or winner** and led **Argentina** to **World Cup glory in Qatar in 2022**.

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] Important Points__**

 
• The **2026 FIFA World Cup** will be co-hosted by the **USA, Mexico, and Canada**.
 
• In the upcoming tournament, **Argentina** is placed in **Group J** alongside **Austria, Jordan, and Algeria**.
 
• Their opening match is scheduled against **Algeria** at **Kansas City** on **June 16**.
